answers.goal: Scoring more and more projects and ultimately being a more mainstream Hollywood composer.
answers.drew: I used to be a touring guitarist for a heavy metal band in my late-teens, very early-20’s, but started getting opportunities to score small films here in LA, and really fell in love with it. I decided this was what I wanted to dedicate my life to.
answers.seeking: Directors and producers, but I am open to meeting anyone with a great story that needs music!
answers.inspiration: My mother. She had a very, very hard life and worked extremely hard to achieve a happy life. She instilled a deep work ethic in me that I am forever grateful for.
